intended_object: The natural transformation between relative-norm diagrams (open normal subgroups U ↦ compact Hausdorff abelian group of selected U-invariants, with relative norm maps) induced by a morphism of restricted level-compact representations; i.e. the morphism part of the functor restrictedNormDiagramFunctor (from docstring and use).
explanation: The component at U is groupMap f U, the continuous map on selected coefficients that `coefficientMap` defines by applying f's induced map on U-invariants (`LevelCompactRep.mapInvariants`). Naturality is exactly groupMap_relativeNorm, which says the induced maps commute with the relative norms. This is the standard functorial map on fixed points induced by an equivariant map, packaged as a natural transformation of the library's diagrams. Nothing is missing or wrong, and the generality is that of the library's own diagram construction, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has no counterpart.
